programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. programme.desc: Not only does Valentine Casey have trouble escaping his past, but also when it comes to visit him, it's usually with guns blazing.
